model.name: Scenario Skybox Upscale
model.shortDescription: Upscale 360 skybox panoramas up to 8x using FLUX, preserving seamless continuity. Choose stylized or realism mode, add prompts, and enhance fine details.

inputs.description: The skybox image you want to upscale.
inputs.label: Image
inputs.name: image

inputs.description: How much to enlarge the image. The model adds real new detail up to 4096x4096px (for example, a 2048x2048 image at 2x); beyond that size it enlarges without inventing new detail.
inputs.label: Scaling Factor
inputs.name: upscaleFactor

inputs.description: Optional text describing the scene or the detail you want emphasized as it's enhanced.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: Optional images to guide the visual style of the result. Add up to 4.
inputs.label: Style Images
inputs.name: imagePrompt

inputs.description: How closely the result follows your style images. Higher values match them more tightly.
inputs.label: Style Fidelity
inputs.name: imagePromptStrength

inputs.description: How closely the result preserves the original image's structure. Higher values stay truer to the original layout and shapes.
inputs.label: Structure Fidelity
inputs.name: controlnetConditioningScale

inputs.description: How much new, imaginative detail the model adds. Higher values invent more; lower values stay faithful to the source.
inputs.label: Creativity
inputs.name: strength

inputs.description: How many refinement passes the model makes. More can improve quality but take longer.
inputs.label: Steps
inputs.name: numInferenceSteps

inputs.description: Sharpens and enhances fine details in the result. On by default.
inputs.label: Enhance Details
inputs.name: detailsEnable

inputs.description: The base model to use: Stylized (Flux Dev) for artistic or illustrated skyboxes, Realism (Flux Krea Dev) for photographic ones.
inputs.label: Style Preset
inputs.name: baseModel

inputs.description: A number that makes results repeatable. Reusing the same seed and settings produces the same image; leave it empty for a random result each time.
inputs.label: Seed
inputs.name: seed
